contract.policy: allow write iff path is NOT protected (.env, .ssh/, *.pem|key|crt|p12|pfx, .git internals, Windows/System32, Program Files, HKEY_*). Mirrors Shinobi approval CRITICAL_PATH_PATTERNS; a drift-guard test pins them together. The Shinobi write_file/edit_file tools are the executors governed by this certified policy via integrity check 11.2 (declared_effects scope).
